implementation_entrypoints: fsmgen vial run --dut HIAL_SOURCE --backend sv_portable_verilator [RUN_OPTIONS] SOURCE.vial

evidence_legs.durability: Tracked original capture/selection, this deterministic selector, exact per-record cohort data, task and Git. No new runtime or source epoch.
evidence_legs.falsify: Independently traverse complete native objects using the explicit candidate predicate, then compare unique paths, per-path owner/status and actual entrypoint labels/values.
evidence_legs.rederive: Reproduce exact cohorts from the retained complete candidate list and native metadata capture.

scope: Structural selection only. Each record occurs once, including prior root/producer exclusions. Common-field semantics remain the named successors; all remaining fields retain the parent metadata/report/VIAL owners.
